companyNew.autonomyDescription: How much authority does the AI have to act without human approval?

1.label: Level 1 — Copilot
1.description: Every AI action requires explicit human approval. Safe for regulated environments.

2.label: Level 2 — Exception Manager

3.label: Level 3 — Full Autonomous
3.description: AI operates without intervention. Recommended only after extensive testing.

recommendationReasons.dev: Prioritizes code generation and refactoring quality, with stronger reasoning models for senior levels.
recommendationReasons.frontend: Prioritizes UI code quality and component design, with Gemini Pro leading for senior levels.
recommendationReasons.data: Prefers reasoning for data design, pipeline correctness, and analytical decisions.
recommendationReasons.designer: Favors models strong at UX reasoning, visual structure, and clear written specs.
recommendationReasons.qa: Prefers stronger reasoning for review depth, risk analysis, and regression thinking.
recommendationReasons.architect: Favors deep reasoning and architecture synthesis.
recommendationReasons.po: Favors product reasoning, trade-offs, and planning quality.
recommendationReasons.scrummaster: Prefers reasoning and coordination quality for planning, decomposition, and retrospective guidance.
recommendationReasons.devops: Prefers reasoning for infrastructure diagnosis and operational decisions under constraints.
recommendationReasons.security: Prefers reasoning-heavy models for threat analysis, hardening, and policy trade-offs.
recommendationReasons.support: Favors fast, balanced models for clear responses and lightweight triage.
recommendationReasons.generalist: Uses a balanced general-purpose model when the role does not clearly call for a specialist.
